svg.title: Wearable AI: research map
svg.desc: A bottom-up classification tree: wearable AI branches into representation learning, health assessment, reasoning and decision, and adaptive intervention; each has two technical routes. Selected works are examples, not model ancestry.
svg.text: Research roles → technical routes → representative work
How do we learn from body signals?
What can we measure or predict?
How do we estimate effects and act?
How do we deliver and evaluate action?
Datasets & cohorts · Benchmarks & evaluation · Tools, standards & governance
Independent facets: signal / sensor · task / population · architecture · evidence
Branches are editorial categories, not mandatory pipeline steps or inheritance claims.
